name: XCC_BCE_TRANSACTION_SOURCES
description: This table holds the disablement information for Budgetary Control and the Encumbrance Accounting for the transaction sources. For the Project Expenditure Items flow it represents the Transaction Sources not enabled for the Project Accounting Business Function.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Corresponds to the business unit identifier.

columns.name: BUSINESS_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: It is the identifier of the business functions.

columns.name: DISABLEMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Represents whether the disablement is for Budgetary Control or Encumbrance Accounting.

columns.name: ALL_DOCUMENT_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if all Project Document Types associated with this Transaction Source are disabled. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction source that is not enabled for budgetary control or encumbrance accounting.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
